name: Feature Request
description: Suggest an idea or enhancement for SynaptoRoute
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: problem
    attributes:
      label: Problem or Motivation
      description: Is your feature request related to a problem or specific use case?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: solution
    attributes:
      label: Proposed Solution
      description: Describe the solution or feature API you'd like to see.
    validations:
      required: true
